semiconductor_relevance: High — iGlobal is a key player in the refurbishment and trading of semiconductor manufacturing equipment, particularly for front-end processes.
summary: iGlobal specializes in trading and refurbishing second-source parts and surplus equipment for semiconductor front-end processes. With a strong focus on AMAT Endura equipment, the company provides high-quality refurbished equipment and engineering services, collaborating with manufacturers to enhance quality and reduce costs.
capabilities: Engineering services tailored to semiconductor manufacturing

regional_presence.Japan: iGlobal operates a subsidiary in Japan, focusing on refurbishment and trading of semiconductor equipment.
regional_presence.Korea: iGlobal has a subsidiary in Korea, enhancing its presence in the Asian semiconductor market.
